name: Onboard Automation Bridge
description: Service-agnostic browser automation proxy with local macro replay mode. Executes fetch/form/XHR commands from your real browser context to bypass hCaptcha enterprise. Supports standalone macro replay (no backend) or optional WS connection to a Python dev daemon for agent-driven interactive debugging.

content_security_policy.extension_pages: script-src 'self' 'wasm-unsafe-eval'; object-src 'self'; connect-src wss: https: http: ws:
